mentions.title: King main bearings setting up loose?
mentions.snippet: A builder reports a 2024-production King main bearing measuring out of spec on free spread, and says the concern carried into a 2025 production run; other posters note they have used King mains since 2024 without problems.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: An explicit buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings. The title itself is framed as a warning to other builders.
mentions.replyNote: Readable today for the first time after months of 403s: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, last post dated 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: A shop reports King STDX thrust bearings for BMW S85/S65 engines measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit, with the same result across multiple bearing sets and multiple blocks.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: A buyer reports one King SI main shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted so it fits poorly, plus machining shavings and oil found in the packaging of the rod bearings.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: A customer received a King XP set containing a mismatched half shell and reports being told to return the set to the supplier rather than being sent a replacement pair; the complaint is about service as much as the part.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: A thread titled as a decision to stop using King XP bearings. King replied in-thread with a technical explanation about the eccentric profile and offered to investigate the specific parts.
mentions.replyNote: Re-confirmed: King replied in-thread explaining the eccentric bearing profile and offering to investigate the specific parts if details are provided.
